instruction:
You write tests/cards/model.examples.test.ts only. Import validateCard and loadDeck from "../../src/cards/model.js", types from "../../src/cards/types.js", and fixture/fixtureJson from "../helpers.js"; the fixtures named in section 2.1 of docs/TASK_P1_cards.md hold every example's input (tests/fixtures/cards/*.json for single cards, tests/fixtures/decks/*.json for decks). One test(...) per example below, in this order, named `<Function> example <n>`; then at most twelve tests of your own on the rules of section 2.2. Compare faults as faults.length, faults[0].key and faults[0].message with toBe against the exact strings of section 2.2; narrow a CardResult with `if (!r.ok) ...` and fail with expect.unreachable, never with a cast. Write no file anywhere (loadDeck takes text, not a path).

The examples below are the criterion, and you are its independent author: write one test per example (no fewer, no merging), and each test's docstring names the Function and the example number, e.g. `Validate Card example 1`.

Examples of Function Validate Card:
1. given {"customId":"a","intent":"generate","targets":["src/a.ts"],"instruction":"x"}; when validated; then a Card with contextSlice [], variants 1, dependsOn [], acceptance null
2. given {"customId":"bad id","intent":"generate","targets":["src/a.ts"],"instruction":"x"}; when validated; then one fault: customId 'bad id' does not match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$
3. given {"customId":"a","intent":"todo","targets":[],"instruction":""}; when validated; then exactly three faults, in key order: intent, targets, instruction
4. given {"customId":"a","intent":"generate","targets":["src/a.ts","./src/a.ts"],"instruction":"x"}; when validated; then one fault: targets repeat src/a.ts after normalisation

Examples of Function Load Deck:
1. given a file with cards a, b, b; when loaded; then one deck fault: duplicate customId b
2. given cards a (dependsOn [b]) and b (dependsOn [a]); when loaded; then one deck fault naming the cycle a -> b -> a
3. given card a with dependsOn [zzz] and no card zzz; when loaded; then no fault; externalDependsOn of the Deck is ['zzz']
